authorization: After validating the ordinary autonomous agent, compare two final training scopes for each released task, then freeze and evaluate all four outputs together.
freeze: Commit identities for both training scopes on both tasks, the checked portable artifacts, training-only validation evidence and selection policy before reading any official feature.
inference: Use the same feature-only packet, row order, software and accuracy definition across arms. Seal all four frozen output files before materialising any official target.
labels: Task1 features and labels are separate arrays. For Task2 the feature phase materialises exactly headline_A and headline_B from the joint CSV. Read label_pairwise only after both arms on both tasks have sealed predictions.
metric: Report both accuracies, counts, net changes and paired corrections/regressions, including a drop or a tie. The primary result remains train_only regardless of outcomes. No tuning, switching arms or further development on official test data.
delivery: No raw final features, answers, individual predictions or official scores go in the public branch. Local delivery includes the four predictions, hashes and scores. Do not send to the course, change main or touch H2.

arms.train_only: Primary course result, designated before opening official test data. Reuse the exact trained and validated model.
arms.train_plus_validation: Prespecified secondary comparison. Refit every selected supervised component on training plus designated validation, preserving its feature pipeline, hyperparameters, random seeds and vote structure. Do not search, tune, or use the designated validation set as independent evidence for this arm.

model_provenance.Task1: Keep the seed-averaged agent election from the 2026-11-28 ordinary training run, previously validated at 1561/2030.
model_provenance.Task2: Use the 2026-11-27 independently elected three-member predictor already requested for integration, trained on 8301 rows and scored at 710/940. The 2026-11-28 general 64-fit-window run instead produced 693/940 and is retained as development evidence. Do not score this separate model on the official test. Verify byte-for-byte within the new runtime, including preserved weights and resource revisions, before the official comparison. The two training scopes use the same Task2 election.
model_provenance.reproduction: Additionally exercise the historical open 22-fit, 1800-second solve with its whole original resource inventory under current source once on the training packet, with no model hints. Compare to the known validation output by file digest only. If this hardware-aware cold run differs, report that separately. Do not iterate based on designated or official scores; the already elected historical fitted artifact is the registered delivery.
